summary: This diff wires task-gateway.py's cmd_submit to mandatorily pipe every --source owner submission through the already-merged scripts/prompt_gateway/gateway.py before any downstream keyword extraction, log-instruction, duplicate/search/knowledge, or capability-lookup call touches the text, adds a new read-only machine-language query CLI (scripts/prompt_gateway/query.py) over gateway.py's saved chat records, and retrofits the pre-existing lookup-capability call site into a documented request/response envelope -- all backed by two new descriptive YAML docs. I independently re-ran the exact commands claimed in the implementation doc (submit --source owner, query.py NEEDS_OWNER_CLARIFICATION, a nonexistent chat_id) and got materially the same real output the doc claims, confirmed superboss-register.py's log-instruction --metadata flag and lookup-capability's found/matches shape genuinely support the new call sites as described, verified all three YAML files and both Python files parse/compile cleanly, and confirmed the disclosed pre-existing keyword-extraction apostrophe-quoting bug already existed unchanged in the parent commit rather than being newly introduced. All subprocess calls use argument lists (no shell=True), the gate fails closed (sys.exit(1)) if gateway.py errors rather than silently falling back to raw text, --source ai_agent is untouched, and the diff touches no .github/workflows/** path and no tier2-triggering path (no migrations/schema/auth/permission/payment/billing/rls/security/.env, and the change is net-additive at 779/12). The task's own 19-point honesty breakdown is appropriately conservative (only 2 points claimed fully code-enforced, 6 partial/proof-of-concept, 11 correctly left discipline-only) rather than overclaiming. This is additive, isolated, and matches the tier1 profile.
issues: Pre-existing (not introduced by this task, and honestly disclosed in the implementation doc): extract_keywords_mechanical()'s quoted-string regex matches everything between any two apostrophes, so raw/gated owner text containing contractions ("it's", "you're") produces one garbled keyword term feeding check-duplicate/search/query-knowledge/lookup-capability -- reproduced live during this review. Worth a small follow-up fix but not a blocker for this scope.

Machine-language contract retrofit (query.py + lookup-capability wrapper) is proof-of-concept only, applied to 2 call sites; the rest of the codebase's ad hoc AI<->software JSON calls are unretrofitted, as the diff itself documents -- flagging for visibility, not as a defect.
